prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” HVAC company for everyone — the best choice depends on your neighborhood, the type/age of your system, whether you need emergency service, and how much warranty/maintenance you want. I can help you pick a reliable provider. Below are practical ways to find the best AC repair company in Houston and a short list of widely known providers you can start with.

How to pick the best company
- Verify licensing and insurance: Ask for the contractor’s Texas license number and verify it at the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR). Confirm they carry liability insurance.
- Technical credentials: Look for NATE-certified technicians and EPA 608 certification (required to handle refrigerants).
- Reputation: Check recent Google/Yelp/Angi/HomeAdvisor reviews and the Better Business Bureau (BBB) page for complaint history.
- Experience with your system: Ask if they’ve repaired your brand/model before.
- Warranties & guarantees: Get written guarantees for parts and labor and ask about a diagnostic fee and whether it’s credited toward repair.
- Pricing & transparency: Get at least 2–3 written estimates that list labor, parts, refrigerant, and any fees.
- Emergency response & availability: If it’s urgent, confirm after-hours availability and typical arrival time.
- Maintenance plans: Ask about tune-up plans to avoid future breakdowns.

Questions to ask when you call
- Are you licensed in Texas? What’s your TDLR license number?  
- Are your techs NATE-certified and EPA-608 certified?  
- Do you carry insurance? Can you provide proof?  
- What’s your diagnostic fee? Is it applied to repair?  
- Do you offer written estimates, parts and labor warranties, and financing?  
- How soon can you come? Do you provide 24/7 emergency service?

Places to research companies
- TDLR license lookup (Texas)  
- Google and Yelp (recent reviews)  
- Better Business Bureau (complaints & ratings)  
- Angi/HomeAdvisor/Nextdoor/Neighborhood Facebook groups

Some reputable companies that commonly serve Houston (start here, but still vet each one)
- John Moore Services (long-established Houston company)  
- ABC Home & Commercial Services (regional company with big Houston presence)  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (national/regional firm with local branches)  
- Locally owned HVAC shops and well-reviewed independent contractors (often great for quick, personalized service)

Next step
If you want, tell me your Houston ZIP code or neighborhood and whether this is an emergency. I’ll give a short, tailored checklist and a suggested script for calling 3 local contractors so you can compare quotes quickly.
